title: Pub/Sub: topics, subscriptions, ordering and dead-letter queues

videos.script: Quitanda's app sends an event every time a customer does something. A product viewed, a cart filled, a payment made. {{events}} Two services want those events. Billing needs the payments within seconds. Analytics wants everything. {{two}} In Pub/Sub, the app publishes once, to a topic. Each service reads from a subscription of its own, and each one gets its own copy. {{fanout}} A message stays in a subscription until the reader acknowledges it. If the reader fails, the message comes back. {{ack}} You will run all of this against the emulator on your laptop. You will filter billing down to payments, and keep each customer's events in order with a key. {{order}} Then a payment nobody can read. After five tries it moves to a dead-letter topic, where a person can look at it. {{dead}} You will also find where the emulator is weaker than Google. It breaks the order you asked for, and it ignores a retry policy. {{weaker}} Last, the bill, which is counted in bytes, for every subscription. {{bill}}
